title: atlax claim (the body a starting card posts to Hestia)
description: Which card, in which factory, is changing which elements of which artifact. Posted when a card starts; an overlap with an open claim warns both FSEs and blocks nothing; publish or card close releases it (implementation.md step 5, ruled 2026-10-31). Names only: Hestia never holds element content, so designations are strings and nothing else is accepted. Writer: the card's start (factory side, from the card's `touches:`). Reader: Hestia's claims API (a Hestia card, its FSE). Sample: claim.sample.json.

card.description: <initiative>/<card slug>, the card file's name without .md.

artifact.description: The artifact id (plant.yaml `artifact`). One claim per artifact a card touches.

designations.description: The designations the card adds, changes or retires in that artifact. Strings only: no element content.
